Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays between White City and Ealing Broadway/West Ruislip, and between Leytonstone and Epping/Hainault via Newbury Park due to train cancellations. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: Minor delays between Shenfield and Whitechapel following a late finish of engineering work. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line. Tickets are being accepted on London Underground, DLR, Great Western Railway, Southeastern, Thameslink and Local Buses.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Minor delays between Northfields and Heathrow Terminals eastbound only while we fix a track fault at South Ealing. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Weaver.reason: Weaver Line: Until Thursday 16th July, there will be no service between Hackney Downs and Chingford while we conduct urgent repairs to the track following a line side fire near Wood Street. Please use London Underground and London Buses to complete your journey.
